Description

Identify coastal locations around Cornwall where sea kelp, which can sequester vast amounts of carbon from the atmosphere, could be regrown.

Payload changed from a camera based payload to low rate data packet communications payload. Sensors collect data, which can then be retrieved by the satellite, and relayed back to the users.
Notes

Planned to be on the first launch of Virgin Orbit's LauncherOne from the UK. Changed from 3U to 6U.
